description.narrative: The Fund is expected to increase access to private equity capital and value creation for companies in Türkiye. Following the 2018 Lira crisis, Türkiye has experienced a notable downturn in private equity investment causing limited access to equity capital. Within this context, Mediterra will provide growth capital to mid-market companies in the country and support value creation in its portfolio through management improvement, expansion strategies and optimizing operations. Additionally, it will assist companies with macroeconomic risk management and facilitate stress testing, focusing on pricing, financials, and foreign exchange. Beyond the project, IFC will support the PE market to remain functioning and provide capital to growth stage companies after a decline in investment due to macroeconomic and political uncertainty. Protracted growth and poor commercial returns have driven many investors and fund managers out of the market, leaving a limited number of active players. IFCs investment with Mediterra III will support one of the mid-market fund managers to sustain activity and sends a signal to other funds seeking to raise in the region. This signal builds on IFCs recent support to other funds in the region and will help to sustain activity during the current environment, support market recovery by preserving critical market capacity, and encourage commercial investors to return to the market.

The proposed project consists of an IFC equity commitment of up to EUR 25 million to Mediterra Capital Partners III LP (MCP III or the Fund) a closed-end private equity fund targeting investments in Türkiye. The Fund will be domiciled in Guernsey with a target size of EUR 165 million
